data.description:
## Description
**What**: Deliver the three SC9 cross-epic coordination items: (i) extend a03c's haiku migration of brainstorm:complete-tagged epics to also emit INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM with deferred=true entries per end-state-classified item; (ii) post a ticket comment to a03c-d55e-1393-4f27 referencing 94ed-f55c-51f5-45f6 and SC9 documenting the dependency; (iii) amend a03c's epic description via PR to add a sub-bullet under its migration SC referencing the manifest backfill step.
**Why**: Brings legacy brainstorm-complete epics into the manifest so the validator and downstream consumers operate over the full backlog, not only newly-brainstormed epics.
**Scope**:
- IN: the migration-script extension; the coordination ticket comment; the a03c epic-description PR amendment; the 2-SC fixture proving exactly 2 deferred=true entries with valid intent_ids.
- OUT: a03c's base migration mechanics (external blocker owns these).

## Done Definitions

- a03c's migration script, run over a fixture epic whose description has 2 end-state SCs, produces exactly 2 INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM entries each with deferred=true and an intent_id matching the SC1 slug regex ← Satisfies: sc-9
- A ticket comment is posted on a03c-d55e-1393-4f27 that references 94ed-f55c-51f5-45f6 and SC9 and documents the cross-epic dependency ← Satisfies: sc-9
- a03c's epic description gains, via PR, a sub-bullet under its migration SC referencing the manifest backfill step ← Satisfies: sc-9
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic in the migration backfill extension, including the 2-SC fixture count assertion ← Satisfies: sc-9

## Considerations

- [External blocker] Depends on a03c-d55e owning the haiku migration script this story extends; this is a cross-epic depends_on at the epic level, coordinated via the a03c blocker, not an in-epic story dependency.
- [Cross-epic write] Items (ii) and (iii) mutate a03c's ticket and epic description; sequence them so the coordination comment lands before or with the PR amendment.
- [Reuse] The backfill must reuse intent-id-mint.sh so backfilled ids are stable and regex-valid.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an a03c migration owner, I want the haiku migration to backfill INTENT_ALLOCATION_BRAINSTORM entries for legacy epics, so that pre-94ed brainstorm-complete epics gain a manifest seed.
